offering_description.value: RGC Resources sells natural gas and provides gas delivery to households, businesses, and industrial facilities in Virginia’s Roanoke Valley. It buys gas from wholesale suppliers and delivers it through its local pipeline network.

primary_services.value: local natural gas distribution; transportation of customer-owned gas

customer_segment.value: B2C: households using natural gas for heating, hot water, or cooking; B2B: commercial buildings, private institutions, and industrial facilities

end_markets.value: residential energy; commercial and institutional buildings; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: natural gas supplied to utility customers; transaction or usage fees: metered delivery and transportation of natural gas; service fees: fixed utility customer charges
revenue_model.category: product sales; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys wholesale natural gas and supplies households, businesses, and industrial facilities; asset operator: receives gas from upstream pipelines and delivers it through its own local mains and service lines

geography_served.value: US regional: Roanoke, Salem, and surrounding communities in western Virginia

specialization.value: niche specialist: local natural gas supply, distribution, and transportation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct utility accounts with delivery through local pipelines to customer meters

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Virginia State Corporation Commission oversight of utility rates and service, plus federal pipeline safety rules
